title: Kink collisions in a two-dimensional gravity model
summary: We numerically study kink-antikink collisions in the self-gravitating $φ^4$ model coupled to the two-dimensional dilaton gravity theory proposed by Mann et al. The static kink solutions interpolate between an anti-de Sitter (AdS$_2$) region and a Minkowski region, and can be regarded as two-dimensional analogues of certain thick branes.
